description: Unofficial fan art of Persona 5 Joker. A fully clothed youthful companion with abstract star-card handling, mask-check coat turns, a paper-key puzzle, safe card-catch recovery and three articulated running directions. The original reference dagger is omitted entirely; props are only blank abstract cards and thick paper tiles. Independently drawn original choreography with a small theatrical leap; no affiliation or endorsement.
author: Cozy Critters Studio
